reviewItem.question: For "Promote image CLI commands to stable by @dgunzy in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5421", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the operator's scripts or workflows invoke the flux image CLI commands that were promoted to stable
